study type: Nationwide, multicenter, retrospective cohort questionnaire survey
exposure: Indication for IUT (complicated monochorionic diamniotic twins, red-cell alloimmunization, parvovirus B19 infection)
cohort: 66 cases who underwent IUT from 2011 to 2015 at 19 institutions in Japan
finding: The study found that IUT was performed mainly for complicated monochorionic diamniotic twins, red-cell alloimmunization, and parvovirus B19 infection, with a favorable overall neonatal survival rate of 77.3%, although it varied depending on the indication.
